description.narrative: (Guinea): .This funding will support the position of the CDC President's Malaria Initiative (PMI) Advisor located.in the USAID Mission. The CDC Advisor will provide technical and programmatic.support to PMI activities in country, provide guidance to U.S. Government activities, and work with Government of Guinea counterparts. ...

Atténuer l'impact sur la santé des maladies infectieuses et d'autres problèmes de santé publique grâce à la mise en œuvre de programmes de santé communautaires holistiques à grande échelle de manière à maximiser la durabilité et à cibler les populations les plus vulnérables et à risque.

(Guinée) : Ce financement soutiendra le poste de conseiller de l'Initiative présidentielle contre le paludisme (PMI) du CDC situé au sein de la mission de l'USAID. Le conseiller du CDC fournira un soutien technique et programmatique aux activités de PMI dans le pays, fournira des conseils aux activités du gouvernement américain et travaillera avec ses homologues du gouvernement de Guinée. ...

El Asesor de los CDC brindará apoyo técnico y programático a las actividades de PMI en el país, brindará orientación a las actividades del gobierno de los EE. UU. y trabajará con sus contrapartes del gobierno de Guinea. ...

description.narrative: The Interagency Agreement (IAA) with the US Census Bureau (USCB) (PRH) seeks to increase the quality, quantity, and utility of country-level data to support the 2020 Round of Censuses and the data requirements of SDGs. This IAA strengthens the capability of statistical offices in developing countries to collect, analyze, disseminate, and use data to increase understanding of population structure and demographic trends and their implications for development planning and policy-making. Emphasis is placed on capacity building; technical assistance provided through this IAA can be in support of the census, surveys, or general institutional capacity building..

Cet IAA renforce la capacité des bureaux de statistique des pays en développement à collecter, analyser, diffuser et utiliser des données pour mieux comprendre la structure de la population et les tendances démographiques ainsi que leurs implications pour la planification du développement et l'élaboration des politiques. L'accent est mis sur le renforcement des capacités ; L'assistance technique fournie dans le cadre de cet AAI peut soutenir le recensement, les enquêtes ou le renforcement des capacités institutionnelles générales.

O Acordo Interinstitucional (IAA) com o US Census Bureau (USCB) (PRH) procura aumentar a qualidade, a quantidade e a utilidade dos dados a nível nacional para apoiar a Ronda de Censos de 2020 e os requisitos de dados dos ODS. Esta IAA reforça a capacidade dos institutos de estatística nos países em desenvolvimento para recolher, analisar, divulgar e utilizar dados para aumentar a compreensão da estrutura populacional e das tendências demográficas e das suas implicações para o planeamento do desenvolvimento e a elaboração de políticas. A ênfase é colocada na capacitação; a assistência técnica fornecida através deste IAA pode ser em apoio ao censo, pesquisas ou capacitação institucional geral.

title.narrative: UNICEF Malaria

description.narrative: The purpose of this agreement is to continue the partnership between UNICEF and USAID to support malaria programming for the President's Malaria Initiative (PMI) and other USAID malaria programs. The agreement primarily focuses on the procurement, supply, and distribution of malaria prevention and treatment commodities in both PMI focus countries and non-focus countries.

description.narrative: To provide support to FAO to carry out collaborative activities with USAID to prevent and control highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) and other emerging zoonotic diseases of significant public health concern as well as other diseases, such as H1N1 influenza, that can infect both humans and animals. The overall objective is to reduce the risk of human exposure by reducing infections in animals.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

Fournir un soutien à la FAO pour mener des activités de collaboration avec l'USAID pour prévenir et contrôler la grippe aviaire hautement pathogène (IAHP) et d'autres maladies zoonotiques émergentes présentant un grave problème de santé publique, ainsi que d'autres maladies, telles que la grippe H1N1, qui peuvent infecter à la fois les humains et les animaux. L'objectif global est de réduire le risque d'exposition humaine en réduisant les infections chez les animaux.

Prestar apoio à FAO na realização de atividades de colaboração com a USAID para prevenir e controlar a gripe aviária de alta patogenicidade (GAAP) e outras doenças zoonóticas emergentes que suscitam preocupação significativa em termos de saúde pública, bem como outras doenças, como a gripe H1N1, que pode infectar humanos e animais. O objectivo geral é reduzir o risco de exposição humana através da redução de infecções em animais.

title.narrative: The Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition (GAIN)
A Aliança Global para uma Nutrição Melhorada (GAIN)

description.narrative: GAIN the Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition is an alliance of national and international public and private organizations that promote nutrition-based solutions to address undernutrition among those most in need. GAIN was created at a special UN session for children in 2002, and is now formally a Foundation under Swiss Law. Currently, GAIN receives funding from the US Agency for International Development, the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, the Canadian International Development Agency, the Childrens Investment Fund Foundation, and a number of governments and charitable groups.

GAIN, a Aliança Global para uma Nutrição Melhorada, é uma aliança de organizações públicas e privadas nacionais e internacionais que promovem soluções baseadas na nutrição para combater a subnutrição entre os mais necessitados. A GAIN foi criada numa sessão especial da ONU para crianças em 2002 e é agora formalmente uma Fundação ao abrigo da legislação suíça. Atualmente, o GAIN recebe financiamento da Agência dos EUA para o Desenvolvimento Internacional, da Fundação Bill e Melinda Gates, da Agência Canadense de Desenvolvimento Internacional, da Fundação do Fundo de Investimento para Crianças e de vários governos e grupos de caridade.

Fournir un soutien à la FAO pour mener des activités de collaboration avec l'USAID pour prévenir et contrôler la grippe aviaire hautement pathogène (IAHP) et d'autres maladies zoonotiques émergentes présentant un grave problème de santé publique, ainsi que d'autres maladies, telles que la grippe H1N1, qui peuvent infecter à la fois les humains et les animaux. L'objectif global est de réduire le risque d'exposition humaine en réduisant les infections chez les animaux.

description.narrative: The purpose of this grant is to support the IFRCs efforts to prevent and control malaria and tuberculosis. This grant will provide a flexible and simple means for USAID operating units to access the Federations headquarters and field office expertise to support tuberculosis and malaria activities. Through individual proposals, USAID missions or headquarters will be able to work with IFRC to customize scopes of work, work-plans, budgets, and indicators to meet the needs of the country, USAID mission and IFRC, in coordination with other funding partners.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

Le but de cette subvention est de soutenir les efforts de la Fédération internationale pour prévenir et contrôler le paludisme et la tuberculose. Cette subvention fournira aux unités opérationnelles de l'USAID un moyen flexible et simple d'accéder à l'expertise du siège de la Fédération et des bureaux extérieurs pour soutenir les activités de lutte contre la tuberculose et le paludisme. Grâce à des propositions individuelles, les missions ou le siège de l'USAID pourront travailler avec la Fédération internationale pour personnaliser les domaines de travail, les plans de travail, les budgets et les indicateurs afin de répondre aux besoins du pays, de la mission de l'USAID et de la Fédération internationale, en coordination avec d'autres partenaires financiers.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Le but de cette subvention est de soutenir les efforts de la Fédération internationale pour prévenir et contrôler le paludisme et la tuberculose. Cette subvention fournira aux unités opérationnelles de l'USAID un moyen flexible et simple d'accéder à l'expertise du siège de la Fédération et des bureaux extérieurs pour soutenir les activités de lutte contre la tuberculose et le paludisme. Grâce à des propositions individuelles, les missions ou le siège de l'USAID pourront travailler avec la Fédération internationale pour personnaliser les domaines de travail, les plans de travail, les budgets et les indicateurs afin de répondre aux besoins du pays, de la mission de l'USAID et de la Fédération internationale, en coordination avec d'autres partenaires financiers.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

title.narrative: Malaria
Paludisme
Paludisme

description.narrative: Support the implementation of the Presidents Malaria Initiative (PMI), related malaria control programs, and malaria research activities to reduce malaria-related mortality. Develop effective malaria vaccines, new malaria treatment drugs, and targeted operations research.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

Soutenir la mise en œuvre de la Presidents Malaria Initiative (PMI), des programmes de lutte contre le paludisme associés et des activités de recherche sur le paludisme afin de réduire la mortalité liée au paludisme. Développer des vaccins efficaces contre le paludisme, de nouveaux médicaments pour le traitement du paludisme et une recherche opérationnelle ciblée.

title.narrative: Walter Reed Army Institute of Research Umbrella IAA

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:Strengthen Nigeria's capacity for malaria diagnosis and laboratory quality assurance and control systems, conduct annual laboratory supportive supervision, and maintain the slide bank in one reference laboratory;.Improve the testing rate for suspected malaria cases, and consequently result in improved case management of malaria, rational use of antimalarial drugs, and reduced malaria-associated mortality; and.Strengthen USAID's localization efforts of Nigeria's disease detection and management capability..Malaria contributes significantly to morbidity and mortality of Nigerian children and pregnant women with a national prevalence of 23 percent (Demographic and Health Survey, 2018). The Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR) program works collaboratively between the U.S. Department of Defense and the Nigerian Ministry of Defense to strengthen laboratory testing for HIV and malaria. The program provides specialized technical assistance to improve diagnostic capacity at the national and state levels, develops standard operating procedures and provides training in malaria microscopy and rapid diagnostic testing. This activity contributes directly to USAID Nigeria CDCS Development Objective 2, the Embassy's ICS, and is closely aligned with Goal 3 of the 2022-2026 Joint Strategic Plan..

(managing partner) and its partners, AIDSTAR-One provides targeted assistance in knowledge management, program implementation support, technical leadership, program sustainability, and strategic planning.

title.narrative: South Sudan HIV/AIDS Program (SSHAP)

description.narrative: The South Sudan HIV/AIDS Program (SSHAP) works to prevent HIV among commercial sex workers, their clients and long-distance truck drivers in Central Equatoria State, Western Equatoria State and Eastern Equatoria State. Implemented by a consortium led by FHI 360 and funded by the U.S. Agency for International Development, the program uses data-driven, evidence-based and cost-effective social marketing strategies to promote protective behaviors and HIV-related services among people who are at a high risk of contracting HIV. The program also works to increase the accessibility and availability of branded and generic condoms in targeted locations. Originally called the Sudan HIV and AIDS Program, the programs name was changed to reflect South Sudans new status as an independent country.

title.narrative: Strengthening Pharmaceutical Systems (SPS)
Fortalecimento dos Sistemas Farmacêuticos (SPS)

description.narrative: The mandate of SPS is to improve access to and use of medicines and health commodities of assured quality for priority health interventions, with a focus on assuring effective pharmaceutical services to achieve desired health outcomes. The new international health environment, characterized by ambitious treatment targets and vastly increased resources for medicines, poses unique challenges but offers unprecedented opportunities for health program development. SPS employs innovative approaches to strengthen pharmaceutical systems and foster south-tosouth capacity building. In the pharmaceutical governance arena, SPS advances the USG agenda, including combating corruption, promoting transparency and accountability, and strengthening regulatory capacity to protect public health. Addressing the growing threat posed by accelerating antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is also a major area of work. Continuing the technical leadership agenda of the RPM Plus Program, SPS provides pharmaceutical management support to global health initiatives, enables donor coordination, facilitates harmonization of tools, and disseminates best practices.

O mandato do SPS é melhorar o acesso e a utilização de medicamentos e produtos de saúde de qualidade garantida para intervenções de saúde prioritárias, com foco na garantia de serviços farmacêuticos eficazes para alcançar os resultados de saúde desejados. O novo ambiente de saúde internacional, caracterizado por metas de tratamento ambiciosas e recursos enormemente aumentados para medicamentos, coloca desafios únicos, mas oferece oportunidades sem precedentes para o desenvolvimento de programas de saúde. O SPS emprega abordagens inovadoras para fortalecer os sistemas farmacêuticos e promover o desenvolvimento de capacidades de sul a sul. Na área da governação farmacêutica, o SPS faz avançar a agenda do Governo dos EUA, incluindo o combate à corrupção, a promoção da transparência e da responsabilização e o reforço da capacidade regulamentar para proteger a saúde pública. Enfrentar a crescente ameaça representada pela aceleração da resistência antimicrobiana (RAM) é também uma importante área de trabalho. Dando continuidade à agenda de liderança técnica do Programa RPM Plus, a SPS fornece apoio de gestão farmacêutica a iniciativas globais de saúde, permite a coordenação de doadores, facilita a harmonização de ferramentas e dissemina as melhores práticas.

title.narrative: Maternal and Child Health

description.narrative: Increase the availability and use of proven life-saving interventions that address the major killers of mothers and children and improve their health and nutrition status, including effective maternity care and management of obstetric complications; prevention services including newborn care, routine immunization, polio eradication, safe water and hygiene, and micronutrients; improved maternal, infant and young child feeding; and treatment of life-threatening childhood illnesses.

title.narrative: Polio Eradication and Immunization Support (CORE Group)

description.narrative: The CORE Group Polio Project (CGPP) is a multi-country, multi-partner initiative providing financial support and on-the-ground technical guidance and support to strengthen host country efforts to eradicate polio. A U.S secretariat serves as a global partnership liaison and provides overall technical assistance and financial management in each country to maximize and harmonize resources and coordinate collaboration among partners. Several CORE Group member organizations come together to implement theCORE Group Secretariat model, a time-tested mechanism for increasing coordination and collaboration. Central to the model and to each CGPP country site is an in-country secretariat- a small team of neutral, technical advisors, independent from any one implementing partner. The Secretariat team facilitates communication, coordination, and transparent decision-making among all partners-unifying the community-level expertise of iNGOs and local NGOs with the international knowledge and strategies of the Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) partners.

title.narrative: Food and Nutrition Technical Assistance (FANTA) II Follow-on

description.narrative: FANTA-2 works to improve nutrition and food security policies, strategies and programs through technical support to the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) and its partners, including host country governments, international organizations and nongovernmental organization (NGO) implementing partners (IPs). Focus areas for technical assistance (TA) include maternal and child health and nutrition (MCHN); HIV and other infectious diseases; food security and livelihood strengthening; and emergency, reconstruction and stabilization (ER&S). FANTA-2 develops and adapts approaches to support the design and quality of field programs while building on field experience and research activities to improve and expand the evidence base, methods and global standards for nutrition and food security programming.

title.narrative: Technology, Research, Education and Technical Assistance for Tuberculosis (TREAT TB)

description.narrative: Technology, Research, Education and Technical Assistance for Tuberculosis (TREAT TB) is a cooperative agreement with the International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease (IUATLD), also known as The Union. TREAT TB focuses on field evaluations of diagnostic techniques for TB, clinical trials and operations research to improve patient management, treatment efficacy, disease prevention, and infection control measures for TB and MDR TB. TREAT TB also provides for field support to address key TB and TB/HIV issues through operational research to improve the national TB programs performance.

title.narrative: PREVENT

description.narrative: PREVENT focuses on characterizing risks associated with disease transmission between animals and people and developing risk-mitigation strategies. Specific activities include: characterizing specific practices and behaviors (e.g. bushmeat hunting and butchering, raising wildlife for trade and consumption) that expose people to zoonotic diseases; and developing and deploying risk-mitigation strategies, including a tool for extractive-industry workers to decrease their exposure to emerging zoonoses.

title.narrative: RESPOND

description.narrative: RESPOND is one component of the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID)s Emerging Pandemic Threats (EPT) program, and coordinates with three other projects: PREDICT, PREVENT, and IDENTIFY. RESPOND's purpose is to strengthen the human capacity of countries to identify and respond to outbreaks of newly emergent diseases in a timely and sustainable manner. RESPOND is a project that twins schools of public health and veterinary medicines in the hotspot regions with U.S. counterpart institutions to strengthen the capacities of countries to train cadres of professionals to identify and respond to outbreaks of newly emergent diseases in a timely and sustainable manner. This project develops outbreak investigation and response trainings that merge animal- and human-health approaches toward a comprehensive capacity for disease detection and control. RESPOND partners include DAI, the University of Minnesota, Tufts University, Training and Resources Group, and Ecology and Environment, Inc.

title.narrative: Health Care Improvement
Melhoria dos cuidados de saúde

description.narrative: The Health Care Improvement Project worked to improve essential obstetric and newborn services at the health facility and community levels. The project sought to reduce maternal and newborn morbidity and mortality through the application of effective quality improvement approaches to services ranging from antenatal to postnatal care and family planning services, including institutionalizing active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL). The USAID Mission in Mali engaged URC to work in three additional areas: management of pre-eclampsia and eclampsia, maternal anemia, and family planning counseling and post-partum care.

O Projecto de Melhoria dos Cuidados de Saúde trabalhou para melhorar os serviços obstétricos e neonatais essenciais nas unidades de saúde e a nível comunitário. O projecto procurou reduzir a morbilidade e mortalidade materna e neonatal através da aplicação de abordagens eficazes de melhoria da qualidade aos serviços que vão desde os cuidados pré-natais aos pós-natais e aos serviços de planeamento familiar, incluindo a institucionalização da gestão activa da terceira fase do parto (AMTSL). A Missão da USAID no Mali contratou a URC para trabalhar em três áreas adicionais: gestão da pré-eclâmpsia e eclâmpsia, anemia materna e aconselhamento sobre planeamento familiar e cuidados pós-parto.

description.narrative: The Health Care Improvement Project worked to improve essential obstetric and newborn services at the health facility and community levels. The project sought to reduce maternal and newborn morbidity and mortality through the application of effective quality improvement approaches to services ranging from antenatal to postnatal care and family planning services, including institutionalizing active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL). The USAID Mission in Mali engaged URC to work in three additional areas: management of pre-eclampsia and eclampsia, maternal anemia, and family planning counseling and post-partum care.

El Proyecto de Mejora de la Atención Médica trabajó para mejorar los servicios obstétricos y neonatales esenciales a nivel comunitario y de establecimientos de salud. El proyecto buscaba reducir la morbilidad y mortalidad materna y neonatal mediante la aplicación de enfoques efectivos de mejora de la calidad de servicios que van desde la atención prenatal hasta la atención posnatal y los servicios de planificación familiar, incluida la institucionalización del manejo activo de la tercera etapa del parto. La Misión de USAID en Mali contrató a la URC para trabajar en tres áreas adicionales: manejo de la preeclampsia y eclampsia, anemia materna y asesoramiento en planificación familiar y atención posparto.

El proyecto buscaba reducir la morbilidad y mortalidad materna y neonatal mediante la aplicación de enfoques efectivos de mejora de la calidad de servicios que van desde la atención prenatal hasta la atención posnatal y los servicios de planificación familiar, incluida la institucionalización del manejo activo de la tercera etapa del parto. La Misión de USAID en Mali contrató a la URC para trabajar en tres áreas adicionales: manejo de la preeclampsia y eclampsia, anemia materna y asesoramiento en planificación familiar y atención posparto.

O Projecto de Melhoria dos Cuidados de Saúde trabalhou para melhorar os serviços obstétricos e neonatais essenciais nas unidades de saúde e a nível comunitário. O projecto procurou reduzir a morbilidade e mortalidade materna e neonatal através da aplicação de abordagens eficazes de melhoria da qualidade aos serviços que vão desde os cuidados pré-natais aos pós-natais e aos serviços de planeamento familiar, incluindo a institucionalização da gestão activa da terceira fase do parto (AMTSL). A Missão da USAID no Mali contratou a URC para trabalhar em três áreas adicionais: gestão da pré-eclâmpsia e eclâmpsia, anemia materna e aconselhamento sobre planeamento familiar e cuidados pós-parto.

title.narrative: The A2Z Micronutrient Project

description.narrative: The goal of A2Z: The USAID Micronutrient and Child Blindness Project is to increase the use of key micronutrient and blindness interventions to improve child and maternal health. The technical focus areas of the project are vitamin A supplementation for children under five and newborns, anemia reduction in pregnant women and children, food fortification, and zinc treatment for diarrhea. The expected results of the project are large-scale, sustainable vitamin A supplementation programs, anemia control, expansion of food fortification, and integration of effective approaches, tools, and data collection into national strategies and multiple program platforms.

title.narrative: Tuberculosis Control Assistance Program (TB CAP)
Programa de Assistência ao Controle da Tuberculose (TB CAP)

description.narrative: TB CAP is a Coalition of partners with KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation as the prime and six other organizations as subs including American Thoracic Society (ATS), Family Health International (FHI), the International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease (The Union), Japanese Anti-Tuberculosis Association (JATA), Management Sciences for Health (MSH), World Health Organization (WHO). The Center for Disease Control (CDC) is a member of the Coalition for coordinating purposes but funds can not flow through this mechanism. The focus of TB CAP is to decrease TB morbidity and mortality in USAID priority TB countries through improving case detection and treatment success. There are five key technical areas including: 1) Increased political commitment for DOTS implementation using evidence-based approaches; 2) Strengthened and expanded DOTS programs, especially to the underserved population; 3) Increased public and private sector participation in DOTS implementation; 4) Increased and strengthened TB and HIV/AIDS coordinated and collaborative activities; 5) Improved TB human and institutional capacity for sustainable TB programs. In addition, TB CAP will assist countries to scale-up country programs to provide national DOTS coverage, apply lessons learned and state-of-the-art approaches, leverage resources to increase impact through collaboration and coordination, integrate TB programs into health systems, and improve the gender, equity and equality of program activities.

TB CAP é uma coalizão de parceiros com a KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation como principal e seis outras organizações como subs, incluindo American Thoracic Society (ATS), Family Health International (FHI), União Internacional Contra Tuberculose e Doenças Pulmonares (The Union), Associação Japonesa Anti-Tuberculose (JATA), Management Sciences for Health (MSH), Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS). O Centro de Controlo de Doenças (CDC) é membro da Coligação para fins de coordenação, mas os fundos não podem fluir através deste mecanismo. O foco do TB CAP é diminuir a morbidade e mortalidade por TB nos países prioritários da USAID para TB, melhorando a detecção de casos e o sucesso do tratamento. Existem cinco áreas técnicas principais, incluindo: 1) Maior compromisso político para a implementação do DOTS utilizando abordagens baseadas em evidências; 2) Programas DOTS fortalecidos e ampliados, especialmente para a população carente; 3) Aumento da participação dos sectores público e privado na implementação do DOTS; 4) Aumento e reforço das actividades coordenadas e colaborativas contra a TB e o VIH/SIDA; 5) Melhor capacidade humana e institucional de TB para programas sustentáveis ​​de TB. Além disso, o TB CAP ajudará os países a ampliar os programas nacionais para fornecer cobertura DOTS nacional, aplicar as lições aprendidas e abordagens de ponta, mobilizar recursos para aumentar o impacto através da colaboração e coordenação, integrar os programas de TB nos sistemas de saúde e melhorar o género, a equidade e a igualdade das atividades do programa.

description.narrative: (Uganda): .Building on the successes of Fistula Care, this activity uses FY 2016 maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH), family planning, and reproductive health funds to address and scale up obstetric fistula prevention. It repairs and enhances linkages, and leverages MNCH and FP through reintegrating activities in support of the GHI/Uganda goal of integrating services. It works with private sector and civil society to support treatment advocacy, rehabilitation and engage government institutions and systems and with Lacor Hospital in Northern Uganda and Jinja Hospital in Eastern Uganda, addressing equity in service delivery. USAID will transform the lives of women living with fistula by working with partners and key stakeholders to address the underlying causes and to harmonize fistula support to the Government of Uganda..

description.narrative: Under IMaD, MCDI and its partners work to improve laboratory-based diagnosis of malaria (primarily at Ministry of Health facilities), and to increase understanding, acceptance, and correct use of microscopy and Rapid Diagnostic Tests (RDTs) by laboratory staff and health care practitioners providing direct care to patients.

(Ouganda) : S'appuyant sur les succès de Fistula Care, cette activité utilise les fonds consacrés à la santé maternelle, néonatale et infantile (SMNI), à la planification familiale et à la santé reproductive de l'exercice 2016 pour aborder et intensifier la prévention de la fistule obstétricale. Il rétablit et renforce les liens et exploite la SMNI et la PF à travers des activités de réintégration à l'appui de l'objectif de GHI/Ouganda d'intégration des services. Il travaille avec le secteur privé et la société civile pour soutenir la promotion du traitement, la réadaptation et impliquer les institutions et systèmes gouvernementaux, ainsi qu'avec l'hôpital Lacor dans le nord de l'Ouganda et l'hôpital Jinja dans l'est de l'Ouganda, pour aborder l'équité dans la prestation de services. L'USAID transformera la vie des femmes vivant avec la fistule en travaillant avec des partenaires et des parties prenantes clés pour s'attaquer aux causes sous-jacentes et harmoniser le soutien à la fistule avec le gouvernement ougandais.

Dans le cadre de l'IMaD, MCDI et ses partenaires travaillent à améliorer le diagnostic du paludisme en laboratoire (principalement dans les établissements du ministère de la Santé) et à accroître la compréhension, l'acceptation et l'utilisation correcte de la microscopie et des tests de diagnostic rapide (TDR) par le personnel de laboratoire et les professionnels de la santé fournissant des soins directs aux patients.

description.narrative: (Zimbabwe): USAID's Maternal and Child Health Integrated Program (MCHIP) provides technical assistance to the Ministy of Health and Child Care to improve the quality of maternal newborn and child health (MNCH) services delivered in Manicaland province. With FY 2015 funding, the project will continue to expand support from two to all seven districts in Manicaland province through implementation of the following activities: -Assist with formulation of national health policies, strategies, and programs that increase access to affordable, evidence-based, high impact MNCH interventions-Train and supervise health workers to improve skills in delivering quality services at health facilities and within communities-Strengthen the capacity of civil society organizations to implement MNCH activities and manage USG fundingAdditional funds from Presidential Malaria Initiative will enable MCHIP to provide training and supportive supervision to village health workers to strengthen malaria community case management.These results will contribute to reducing maternal and under-five mortality.

Dans le cadre de l'IMaD, MCDI et ses partenaires travaillent à améliorer le diagnostic du paludisme en laboratoire (principalement dans les établissements du ministère de la Santé) et à accroître la compréhension, l'acceptation et l'utilisation correcte de la microscopie et des tests de diagnostic rapide (TDR) par le personnel de laboratoire et les professionnels de la santé fournissant des soins directs aux patients.

(Zimbabwe) : Le programme intégré de santé maternelle et infantile (MCHIP) de l'USAID fournit une assistance technique au ministère de la Santé et de la Protection de l'enfance pour améliorer la qualité des services de santé maternelle, néonatale et infantile (SMNI) fournis dans la province de Manicaland. Avec le financement de l'exercice 2015, le projet continuera d'étendre son soutien de deux aux sept districts de la province de Manicaland à travers la mise en œuvre des activités suivantes : - Aider à la formulation de politiques, de stratégies et de programmes nationaux de santé qui augmentent l'accès à des interventions de SMNI abordables, fondées sur des données probantes et à fort impact - Former et superviser les agents de santé pour améliorer leurs compétences dans la fourniture de services de qualité dans les établissements de santé et au sein des communautés - Renforcer la capacité des organisations de la société civile à mettre en œuvre des activités de SMNI et à gérer le financement du gouvernement américain. Fonds supplémentaires de l'Initiative présidentielle contre le paludisme permettra au MCHIP de fournir une formation et une supervision formative aux agents de santé villageois afin de renforcer la prise en charge communautaire des cas de paludisme. Ces résultats contribueront à réduire la mortalité maternelle et celle des enfants de moins de cinq ans.

(Zimbabwe): El Programa Integrado de Salud Materna e Infantil (MCHIP) de USAID brinda asistencia técnica al Ministerio de Salud y Atención Infantil para mejorar la calidad de los servicios de salud materna, neonatal e infantil (MNCH) prestados en la provincia de Manicaland. Con la financiación del año fiscal 2015, el proyecto continuará ampliando el apoyo de dos a los siete distritos de la provincia de Manicaland mediante la implementación de las siguientes actividades: -Asistir en la formulación de políticas, estrategias y programas nacionales de salud que aumenten el acceso a intervenciones SMNI asequibles, basadas en evidencia y de alto impacto. -Capacitar y supervisar a los trabajadores de la salud para mejorar las habilidades en la prestación de servicios de calidad en los centros de salud y dentro de las comunidades. -Fortalecer la capacidad de las organizaciones de la sociedad civil para implementar actividades de SMNI y administrar fondos del Gobierno de Estados Unidos. La Iniciativa Presidencial contra la Malaria permitirá a MCHIP brindar capacitación y supervisión de apoyo a los trabajadores de salud de las aldeas para fortalecer la gestión comunitaria de casos de malaria. Estos resultados contribuirán a reducir la mortalidad materna y de niños menores de cinco años.

(Zimbábue): O Programa Integrado de Saúde Materno-Infantil (MCHIP) da USAID presta assistência técnica ao Ministério da Saúde e Cuidados Infantis para melhorar a qualidade dos serviços de saúde materna, neonatal e infantil (MNCH) prestados na província de Manicaland. Com o financiamento do exercício de 2015, o projecto continuará a expandir o apoio de dois para todos os sete distritos na província de Manicaland através da implementação das seguintes actividades: -Ajudar na formulação de políticas, estratégias e programas nacionais de saúde que aumentem o acesso a intervenções de MNCH acessíveis, baseadas em evidências e de alto impacto -Formar e supervisionar os profissionais de saúde para melhorar as competências na prestação de serviços de qualidade nas unidades de saúde e nas comunidades -Fortalecer a capacidade das organizações da sociedade civil para implementar actividades de MNCH e gerir o financiamento do Governo dos EUA Fundos adicionais do Presidente A Iniciativa contra a Malária permitirá ao MCHIP fornecer formação e supervisão de apoio aos profissionais de saúde das aldeias para reforçar a gestão comunitária de casos de malária. Estes resultados contribuirão para reduzir a mortalidade materna e de menores de cinco anos.

Objectives for Central Asia, regional: MCHIP provides assistance to the Kyrgyzstan in order to build capacity for M&E analysis by introducing the Reaching Every District approach (RED) into national, oblast and district systems; improve evidence-based program planning and prioritization; and improve partner coordination on immunization.

description.narrative: Promoting the Quality of Medicines (PQM) serves as a primary mechanism to help USAID-supported countries strengthen their quality assurance and quality control systems to better ensure the quality of medicines that reach patients. Supported by knowledgeable staff and state-of-the-art facilities around the world, PQM strives to accomplish four key objectives: Strengthen quality assurance (QA) and quality control (QC) systems, Increase the supply of quality assured medicines, Combat the availability of substandard and counterfeit medicines, and Provide technical leadership and global advocacy.

(Zimbabwe) : Le programme intégré de santé maternelle et infantile (MCHIP) de l'USAID fournit une assistance technique au ministère de la Santé et de la Protection de l'enfance pour améliorer la qualité des services de santé maternelle, néonatale et infantile (SMNI) fournis dans la province de Manicaland. Avec le financement de l'exercice 2015, le projet continuera d'étendre son soutien de deux aux sept districts de la province de Manicaland à travers la mise en œuvre des activités suivantes : - Aider à la formulation de politiques, de stratégies et de programmes nationaux de santé qui augmentent l'accès à des interventions de SMNI abordables, fondées sur des données probantes et à fort impact - Former et superviser les agents de santé pour améliorer leurs compétences dans la fourniture de services de qualité dans les établissements de santé et au sein des communautés - Renforcer la capacité des organisations de la société civile à mettre en œuvre des activités de SMNI et à gérer le financement du gouvernement américain. Fonds supplémentaires de l'Initiative présidentielle contre le paludisme permettra au MCHIP de fournir une formation et une supervision formative aux agents de santé villageois afin de renforcer la prise en charge communautaire des cas de paludisme. Ces résultats contribueront à réduire la mortalité maternelle et celle des enfants de moins de cinq ans.

La promotion de la qualité des médicaments (PQM) constitue un mécanisme principal pour aider les pays soutenus par l'USAID à renforcer leurs systèmes d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité afin de mieux garantir la qualité des médicaments qui parviennent aux patients. Soutenu par un personnel compétent et des installations de pointe dans le monde entier, PQM s'efforce d'atteindre quatre objectifs clés : renforcer les systèmes d'assurance qualité (AQ) et de contrôle qualité (CQ), augmenter l'offre de médicaments de qualité garantie, combattre la disponibilité de médicaments de qualité inférieure et contrefaits, et assurer un leadership technique et un plaidoyer mondial.

La promotion de la qualité des médicaments (PQM) constitue un mécanisme principal pour aider les pays soutenus par l'USAID à renforcer leurs systèmes d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité afin de mieux garantir la qualité des médicaments qui parviennent aux patients. Soutenu par un personnel compétent et des installations de pointe dans le monde entier, PQM s'efforce d'atteindre quatre objectifs clés : renforcer les systèmes d'assurance qualité (AQ) et de contrôle qualité (CQ), augmenter l'offre de médicaments de qualité garantie, combattre la disponibilité de médicaments de qualité inférieure et contrefaits, et assurer un leadership technique et un plaidoyer mondial.

La Promoción de la Calidad de los Medicamentos (PQM) sirve como mecanismo principal para ayudar a los países apoyados por USAID a fortalecer sus sistemas de garantía y control de calidad para garantizar mejor la calidad de los medicamentos que llegan a los pacientes. Con el respaldo de personal capacitado e instalaciones de última generación en todo el mundo, PQM se esfuerza por lograr cuatro objetivos clave: fortalecer los sistemas de garantía de calidad (QA) y control de calidad (QC), aumentar el suministro de medicamentos de calidad garantizada, combatir la disponibilidad de medicamentos falsificados y de calidad inferior, y proporcionar liderazgo técnico y promoción global.

A Promoção da Qualidade dos Medicamentos (PQM) serve como um mecanismo primário para ajudar os países apoiados pela USAID a reforçar os seus sistemas de garantia e controlo de qualidade para melhor garantir a qualidade dos medicamentos que chegam aos pacientes. Apoiada por pessoal experiente e instalações de última geração em todo o mundo, a PQM se esforça para cumprir quatro objetivos principais: Fortalecer os sistemas de garantia de qualidade (GQ) e controle de qualidade (CQ), Aumentar o fornecimento de medicamentos de qualidade garantida, Combater a disponibilidade de medicamentos de qualidade inferior e falsificados e Fornecer liderança técnica e defesa global.

title.narrative: Child Survival and Health Grants Program (CSHGP) - Save the Children (Zambia)

description.narrative: The CSHGP facilitates a dynamic partnership between USAID and private and voluntary organizations (PVOs)/NGOs. Through the CSHGP, USAID leverages the development entrepreneurship and know how of PVOs/NGOs and their local partners for innovative and effective community-oriented programming that sustainably improves maternal, newborn and child health (MNCH) outcomes, strengthens local and community health systems, and contributes to reductions in morbidity and mortality. PVOs/NGOs, with their local partners (national and local MOH, local NGOs/CBOs, communities), implement in a range of settings, from remote communities in a single district to multiple districts or a province. Projects address critical health needs of vulnerable populationsand work strategically with a systems approach at the household, community,health facility, and policy levels and strengthens linkages as relevant.

description.narrative: NetWorks is a comprehensive and innovative program to build sustainable long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLIN) systems that bridge the key technical areas of advocacy, policy, distribution, monitoring, and communications for increased net access and use in malaria endemic countries. Endemic countries, particularly in Africa, differ widely in resources (financial and human) and experiences with LLIN distribution that contribute to a unique net context in each country. Partnerships and policies vary widely, while procurement and distribution challenges hamper implementation. This combination of issues underscores the need for flexibility inherent in the NetWorks approach. NetWorks emphasizes fitting program activities to the national net context.

La promotion de la qualité des médicaments (PQM) constitue un mécanisme principal pour aider les pays soutenus par l'USAID à renforcer leurs systèmes d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité afin de mieux garantir la qualité des médicaments qui parviennent aux patients. Soutenu par un personnel compétent et des installations de pointe dans le monde entier, PQM s'efforce d'atteindre quatre objectifs clés : renforcer les systèmes d'assurance qualité (AQ) et de contrôle qualité (CQ), augmenter l'offre de médicaments de qualité garantie, combattre la disponibilité de médicaments de qualité inférieure et contrefaits, et assurer un leadership technique et un plaidoyer mondial.

NetWorks est un programme complet et innovant visant à construire des systèmes durables de moustiquaires insecticides de longue durée (MID) qui relient les domaines techniques clés du plaidoyer, de la politique, de la distribution, du suivi et des communications pour un accès et une utilisation accrus des moustiquaires dans les pays d'endémie palustre. Les pays d'endémie, en particulier en Afrique, diffèrent considérablement en termes de ressources (financières et humaines) et d'expériences en matière de distribution de MILD, ce qui contribue à créer un contexte de moustiquaire unique dans chaque pays. Les partenariats et les politiques varient considérablement, tandis que les difficultés d’approvisionnement et de distribution entravent la mise en œuvre. Cette combinaison de problèmes souligne le besoin de flexibilité inhérent à l’approche NetWorks. NetWorks met l'accent sur l'adaptation des activités du programme au contexte national du réseau.

title.narrative: Translating Research into Action (TRAction) Project
Proyecto Traducción de la investigación en acción (TRAction).

description.narrative: The purpose of the Translating Research into Action (TRAction) Project is to accelerate the introduction and scale up of approaches and interventions that when implemented in programs will reduce mortality and severe morbidity in women, newborns and young children. There is a preponderance of evidence on the potential impact of specific maternal, neonatal and child health interventions yet the successful implementation and scale-up of these in countries remains a challenge. TRAction will address this knowledge gap by managing research, introduction and evaluation activities on how to effectively deliver, increase utilization, achieve coverage, and scale-up evidence based newborn, child, maternaland integrated MNCH health and nutrition tools, approaches, interventions and policies that are relevant to field programs.

El propósito del Proyecto Traducir la Investigación en Acción (TRAction) es acelerar la introducción y ampliación de enfoques e intervenciones que, cuando se implementen en programas, reducirán la mortalidad y la morbilidad grave en mujeres, recién nacidos y niños pequeños. Hay una preponderancia de evidencia sobre el impacto potencial de intervenciones específicas de salud materna, neonatal e infantil, pero la implementación exitosa y la ampliación de estas en los países sigue siendo un desafío. TRAction abordará esta brecha de conocimiento mediante la gestión de actividades de investigación, introducción y evaluación sobre cómo implementar de manera efectiva, aumentar la utilización, lograr cobertura y ampliar herramientas, enfoques, intervenciones y políticas de salud y nutrición neonatales, infantiles, maternas y SMNI integradas basadas en evidencia que sean relevantes para los programas de campo.

title.narrative: Sudan Health Transformation Project II (SHTP II)

description.narrative: In the second phase of the Sudan Health Transformation Project (SHTP II), MSH is transitioning health service delivery from relief to development. Specifically, SHTP II is expanding access and coverage by: 1) enhancing quality of health services through an integrated package of high-impact services; 2) increasing demand through community mobilization; 3) engendering the communitys confidence in health services through strengthening of County Health Departments (CHDs) and the MOH. MSH, in partnership with the International Rescue Committee, is working alongside as many as 12 international nongovernmental organizations (NGOs) responsible for delivering primary health services in a target county. The goal is to establish fully functional service delivery points (FFSDP) with coverage of 80 percent of the catchment population in 12 focus counties within three years.

title.narrative: Leadership, Management and Sustainability (LMS) Program
Programa de Liderazgo, Gestión y Sostenibilidad (LMS)

description.narrative: The LMS Program focused on three key result areas: (1) Improving management and leadership of priority health programs; (2) Improving management systems in health organizations and priority programs; and (3) Increasing sustainability and ability to manage change. A primary goal of the program was to develop managers and leaders who achieve results in the areas of family planning and reproductive health, HIV & AIDS, infectious disease, maternal and child health, and many other areas of service delivery.

El programa LMS se centró en tres áreas de resultados clave: (1) mejorar la gestión y el liderazgo de los programas de salud prioritarios; (2) Mejorar los sistemas de gestión en las organizaciones de salud y programas prioritarios; y (3) aumentar la sostenibilidad y la capacidad para gestionar el cambio. Un objetivo principal del programa era desarrollar administradores y líderes que lograran resultados en las áreas de planificación familiar y salud reproductiva, VIH y SIDA, enfermedades infecciosas, salud maternoinfantil y muchas otras áreas de prestación de servicios.

title.narrative: Extending Service Delivery (ESD) for Reproductive Health and Family Planning
Extension de la prestation de services (EDD) pour la santé reproductive et la planification familiale

description.narrative: A three-year project, ESD-Guinea increased the number of family planning service delivery points at the community and facility level, improved the quality of services through training community- and facility-based healthcare providers, and improved the enabling environment by updating the national health policy and guidelines around family planning. To reduce unmet needs in family planning and increase the contraceptive prevalence rate, ESD worked to: 1) Strengthen and update the national norms and guidelines in family planning and reproductive health, including providing assistance with the finalization of the national policy on community-based distribution. 2) Provide technical assistance to public sector family planning programs in order to increase the number of community and facility sites that provide family planning and therefore increase the number of family planning users. 3) Train service providers and managers in family planning and counseling services at health centers, maternity centers, and health posts.

Since 2006, GHFP I POD with its partner Management Systems International (MSI) has provided creative solutions for individual, team and unit performance challenges. Projet de trois ans, ESD-Guinée a augmenté le nombre de points de prestation de services de planification familiale au niveau de la communauté et des établissements, amélioré la qualité des services grâce à la formation des prestataires de soins de santé au sein des communautés et des établissements, et amélioré l'environnement favorable en mettant à jour la politique nationale de santé et les directives concernant la planification familiale. Pour réduire les besoins non satisfaits en matière de planification familiale et augmenter le taux de prévalence contraceptive, ESD a travaillé pour : 1) Renforcer et mettre à jour les normes et directives nationales en matière de planification familiale et de santé reproductive, notamment en fournissant une assistance à la finalisation de la politique nationale de distribution à base communautaire. 2) Fournir une assistance technique aux programmes de planification familiale du secteur public afin d'augmenter le nombre de sites communautaires et d'établissements qui fournissent la planification familiale et donc d'augmenter le nombre d'utilisateurs de la planification familiale. 3) Former les prestataires de services et les gestionnaires aux services de planification familiale et de conseil dans les centres de santé, les maternités et les postes de santé.

Le programme GHFP I POD vise à améliorer l'efficacité du secteur de la santé de l'USAID en développant et en augmentant les capacités de ses professionnels de la santé grâce à des services de développement professionnel et organisationnel de haute qualité dans le monde entier. description.narrative: The goal of PROGRESS is to improve access to family planning among underserved populations through research and research utilization. To achieve this goal, PROGRESS developed a workplan consisting of four legacy areas. The legacy areas comprise the key organizing structure for identifying and implementing activities, monitoring performance, and assessing achievement of desired outcomes. The legacy areas: 1. Maximizing human resources by task-shifting and addressing medical barriers to family planning services 2. Expanding service delivery options within and beyond the health sector 3. Expanding the family planning method mix for home, community, and lower-level provider use 4. Increasing in-country capacity for research and research utilization.

Améliorer les choix contraceptifs en élargissant l'accès aux méthodes basées sur la connaissance de la fécondité (FAM), à la méthode des jours fixes (MJF), à la méthode des deux jours (TDM) et à la méthode de l'allaitement maternel et de l'aménorrhée (LAM), dans les pays en développement. Cette activité répond aux besoins des femmes et des hommes qui souhaitent utiliser un FAM pour éviter une grossesse mais qui manquent d'informations et de compétences pour les utiliser efficacement.

L'objectif de PROGRESS est d'améliorer l'accès à la planification familiale parmi les populations mal desservies grâce à la recherche et à l'utilisation de la recherche. Pour atteindre cet objectif, PROGRESS a élaboré un plan de travail composé de quatre domaines hérités. Les domaines d'héritage comprennent la structure organisationnelle clé pour identifier et mettre en œuvre les activités, suivre les performances et évaluer l'atteinte des résultats souhaités. Les domaines d'héritage : 1. Maximiser les ressources humaines en transférant les tâches et en éliminant les obstacles médicaux aux services de planification familiale 2. Élargir les options de prestation de services au sein et au-delà du secteur de la santé 3. Élargir la combinaison de méthodes de planification familiale pour l'utilisation à domicile, dans la communauté et par les prestataires de niveau inférieur 4. Augmenter la capacité nationale de recherche et d'utilisation de la recherche.

description.narrative: This project strengthens the human resources (HR) needed to implement quality health programs, in both the public and private, particularly the not-for-profit private, sectors. It addresses both the number of healthcare workers needed and the quality and performance of those workers. The definition of healthcare worker is expanded to include HR managers, laboratory staff, pharmacists, social workers, information systems/monitoring and evaluation specialists and others essential to the effective functioning of the health system.

Ce projet renforce les ressources humaines (RH) nécessaires à la mise en œuvre de programmes de santé de qualité, tant dans le secteur public que privé, en particulier le secteur privé à but non lucratif. Il aborde à la fois le nombre de professionnels de santé nécessaires ainsi que la qualité et les performances de ces professionnels. La définition du travailleur de santé est élargie pour inclure les responsables des ressources humaines, le personnel de laboratoire, les pharmaciens, les travailleurs sociaux, les spécialistes des systèmes d'information/suivi et évaluation et autres personnes essentielles au fonctionnement efficace du système de santé.

Este proyecto fortalece los recursos humanos (RRHH) necesarios para implementar programas de salud de calidad, tanto en el sector público como en el privado, particularmente en el privado sin fines de lucro. Aborda tanto la cantidad de trabajadores de la salud necesarios como la calidad y el desempeño de esos trabajadores. La definición de trabajador de la salud se amplía para incluir gerentes de recursos humanos, personal de laboratorio, farmacéuticos, trabajadores sociales, especialistas en sistemas de información/monitoreo y evaluación y otros esenciales para el funcionamiento eficaz del sistema de salud.

Este projecto reforça os recursos humanos (RH) necessários para implementar programas de saúde de qualidade, tanto no sector público como no privado, especialmente no sector privado sem fins lucrativos. description.narrative: The Strengthening Health Outcomes through the Private Sector (SHOPS) project is USAID's flagship initiative in private sector health. It works to involve nongovernmental organizations and for-profit entities in addressing the many health needs of people in developing countries. SHOPS focuses on increasing availability, improving quality, and expanding coverage of essential health products and services in family planning and reproductive health, maternal and child health, HIV and AIDS, and other health areas through the private sector. Note: Follwoing the May, 2013 termination of USAID activities in Bolivia, the SHOPS project is no longer providing thecnical assistance in Bolivia.

Ce projet renforce les ressources humaines (RH) nécessaires à la mise en œuvre de programmes de santé de qualité, tant dans le secteur public que privé, en particulier le secteur privé à but non lucratif. Il aborde à la fois le nombre de professionnels de santé nécessaires ainsi que la qualité et les performances de ces professionnels. La définition du travailleur de santé est élargie pour inclure les responsables des ressources humaines, le personnel de laboratoire, les pharmaciens, les travailleurs sociaux, les spécialistes des systèmes d'information/suivi et évaluation et autres personnes essentielles au fonctionnement efficace du système de santé.

Le projet Strengthening Health Outcomes through the Private Sector (SHOPS) est l'initiative phare de l'USAID dans le domaine de la santé du secteur privé. Il vise à impliquer les organisations non gouvernementales et les entités à but lucratif pour répondre aux nombreux besoins de santé des populations des pays en développement. SHOPS se concentre sur l'augmentation de la disponibilité, l'amélioration de la qualité et l'élargissement de la couverture des produits et services de santé essentiels dans les domaines de la planification familiale et de la santé reproductive, de la santé maternelle et infantile, du VIH et du SIDA et d'autres domaines de santé par le biais du secteur privé. Remarque : Suite à la fin des activités de l'USAID en Bolivie en mai 2013, le projet SHOPS ne fournit plus d'assistance technique en Bolivie.

El proyecto Fortalecimiento de los resultados de salud a través del sector privado (SHOPS) es la iniciativa emblemática de USAID en el sector de salud privado. Trabaja para involucrar a organizaciones no gubernamentales y entidades con fines de lucro para abordar las numerosas necesidades de salud de las personas en los países en desarrollo. description.narrative: The purpose of MEASURE Phase III DHS is to improve the collection, analysis and presentation of data and promote better use in planning, policymaking, managing, monitoring and evaluating population, health and nutrition programs. The project seeks to increase understanding of a wide range of health issues by improving the quality and availability of data on health status and services and enhancing the ability of local organizations to collect, analyze and disseminate such information.

Le projet Strengthening Health Outcomes through the Private Sector (SHOPS) est l'initiative phare de l'USAID dans le domaine de la santé du secteur privé. Il vise à impliquer les organisations non gouvernementales et les entités à but lucratif pour répondre aux nombreux besoins de santé des populations des pays en développement. SHOPS se concentre sur l'augmentation de la disponibilité, l'amélioration de la qualité et l'élargissement de la couverture des produits et services de santé essentiels dans les domaines de la planification familiale et de la santé reproductive, de la santé maternelle et infantile, du VIH et du SIDA et d'autres domaines de santé par le biais du secteur privé. Remarque : Suite à la fin des activités de l'USAID en Bolivie en mai 2013, le projet SHOPS ne fournit plus d'assistance technique en Bolivie.

Le projet Strengthening Health Outcomes through the Private Sector (SHOPS) est l'initiative phare de l'USAID dans le domaine de la santé du secteur privé. Remarque : Suite à la fin des activités de l'USAID en Bolivie en mai 2013, le projet SHOPS ne fournit plus d'assistance technique en Bolivie.

Le but de MEASURE Phase III DHS est d'améliorer la collecte, l'analyse et la présentation des données et de promouvoir une meilleure utilisation dans la planification, l'élaboration des politiques, la gestion, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes de population, de santé et de nutrition. Le projet vise à accroître la compréhension d'un large éventail de problèmes de santé en améliorant la qualité et la disponibilité des données sur l'état et les services de santé et en renforçant la capacité des organisations locales à collecter, analyser et diffuser ces informations.

El propósito de MEASURE Fase III DHS es mejorar la recopilación, el análisis y la presentación de datos y promover un mejor uso en la planificación, formulación de políticas, gestión, seguimiento y evaluación de programas de población, salud y nutrición. El proyecto busca aumentar la comprensión de una amplia gama de problemas de salud mejorando la calidad y disponibilidad de datos sobre el estado y los servicios de salud y mejorando la capacidad de las organizaciones locales para recopilar, analizar y difundir dicha información.

title.narrative: Private Sector Partnerships Project (PSP-1)

description.narrative: The Private Sector Partnerships-One project (PSP-One) was the first of 15 task orders awarded by USAID's Office of Population and Reproductive Health under its Private Sector Program. The project's primary aim was to increase the sustainable provision and use of family planning and other health products and services. Within the broader Private Sector Program, PSP-One also served as USAID's primary vehicle to support core-funded activities related to private sector innovation, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and research, monitoring and evaluation. For USAID missions that did not wish to issue their own Private SectorProgram task order, PSP-One also offered a mechanism to program field support. During its five-year lifespan, the project applied its expertise in 31 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Eastern Europe. PSP-One activities spanned a broad range of technical areas including public-private partnerships, social marketing and pharmaceutical partnerships, private provider networks and social franchising, base-of-the-pyramid market-based partnerships, behavior change communications, policy, quality improvement, and health financing. This PSP-One final report shares PSP-One's most important findings and lessons learned through the presentation of 14 country case studies and a summary of the project's tools and global research.

title.narrative: Supply Chain Management System (SCMS)

description.narrative: The purpose of SCMS is to establish and operate a safe, secure, reliable, and sustainable supply chain management system to procure pharmaceuticals and other products needed to provide care and treatment of persons with HIV/AIDS and related infections. Through creating and enhancing an uninterrupted supply of key commodities, SCMS is intended to support the rapid scale up of HIV/ AIDS prevention, treatment, and care. This includes ensuring the quality of drugs, test kits, and other supplies, and building capacity for long-term sustainable procurement and distribution.

description.narrative: The USAID | DELIVER Project is a five year, worldwide project to design, develop, strengthen, and upon request, operate safe, reliable and sustainable supply systems that provide a range of affordable, quality essential health commodities including drugs, diagnostics, contraceptives and supplies to clients in country programs. The project will improve the availability of essential health supplies in public and private services by strengthening country supply systems, collaborating with global and regional partners for long-term availability of supplies, and improving USAIDs provision of supplies to country programs.

La USAID | El Proyecto DELIVER es un proyecto mundial de cinco años para diseñar, desarrollar, fortalecer y, previa solicitud, operar sistemas de suministro seguros, confiables y sostenibles que proporcionen una gama de productos de salud esenciales, asequibles y de calidad, incluidos medicamentos, diagnósticos, anticonceptivos y suministros a los clientes de los programas nacionales. El proyecto mejorará la disponibilidad de suministros de salud esenciales en servicios públicos y privados fortaleciendo los sistemas de suministro de los países, colaborando con socios globales y regionales para la disponibilidad de suministros a largo plazo y mejorando el suministro de suministros de USAID a los programas de los países.

A USAID | O Projeto DELIVER é um projeto mundial de cinco anos para conceber, desenvolver, fortalecer e, mediante solicitação, operar sistemas de abastecimento seguros, confiáveis ​​e sustentáveis ​​que forneçam uma gama de produtos de saúde essenciais de qualidade e acessíveis, incluindo medicamentos, diagnósticos, contraceptivos e suprimentos para clientes em programas nacionais. O projecto melhorará a disponibilidade de suprimentos essenciais de saúde nos serviços públicos e privados, fortalecendo os sistemas de abastecimento dos países, colaborando com parceiros globais e regionais para a disponibilidade de suprimentos a longo prazo e melhorando o fornecimento de suprimentos da USAID aos programas nacionais.

description.narrative: Supply Chain Management System (SCMS) is a multi-billion dollar PEPFAR Program managed by USAID and implemented by Partnership for Supply Chain Management (PfSCM). The purpose of SCMS is to ensure the supply of quality essential medicines and other products to people impacted by HIV/AIDS, and to promote sustainable supply chains in partner countries, in collaboration with US agencies and other stakeholders. SCMS supports the rapid scale up of HIV/AIDS prevention, care and treatment by providing an uninterrupted supply of key commodities. CMS is implemented by the Partnership for Supply Chain Management, a non-profit consortium of 13 organizations led by John Snow, Inc. Research & Training Institute (JSI) and Management Sciences forHealth (MSH).

Le but de MEASURE Phase III DHS est d'améliorer la collecte, l'analyse et la présentation des données et de promouvoir une meilleure utilisation dans la planification, l'élaboration des politiques, la gestion, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes de population, de santé et de nutrition. Le projet vise à accroître la compréhension d'un large éventail de problèmes de santé en améliorant la qualité et la disponibilité des données sur l'état et les services de santé et en renforçant la capacité des organisations locales à collecter, analyser et diffuser ces informations.

Le système de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (SCMS) est un programme PEPFAR de plusieurs milliards de dollars géré par l'USAID et mis en œuvre par le Partenariat pour la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (PfSCM). L'objectif du SCMS est d'assurer la fourniture de médicaments essentiels et d'autres produits de qualité aux personnes touchées par le VIH/SIDA, et de promouvoir des chaînes d'approvisionnement durables dans les pays partenaires, en collaboration avec les agences américaines et d'autres parties prenantes. SCMS soutient l'intensification rapide de la prévention, des soins et du traitement du VIH/SIDA en fournissant un approvisionnement ininterrompu en produits essentiels. CMS est mis en œuvre par le Partnership for Supply Chain Management, un consortium à but non lucratif de 13 organisations dirigé par John Snow, Inc. Research & Training Institute (JSI) et Management Sciences forHealth (MSH).

title.narrative: Deliver Project Task Order 3 for Malaria
Exécuter l'ordre de tâche 3 du projet pour le paludisme
Exécuter l'ordre de tâche 3 du projet pour le paludisme
Exécuter l'ordre de tâche 3 du projet pour le paludisme
Entregar a Ordem de Tarefa 3 do Projeto para a Malária

description.narrative: To provide USAID Missions and Bureaus with a worldwide mechanism to support the goals and objectives of the Presidents Malaria Initiative and USAIDs goal of reducing the burden of malaria in Africa. It will support USAIDs implementation of malaria prevention and treatment programs through the procurement, management, and delivery of high quality, safe, and effective malaria commodities; the provision of on-the-ground logistics capacity, technical assistance, and pharmaceutical management expertise; and technical leadership to strengthen the global supply, demand, and financing of high quality malaria commodities.

Le système de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (SCMS) est un programme PEPFAR de plusieurs milliards de dollars géré par l'USAID et mis en œuvre par le Partenariat pour la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (PfSCM). L'objectif du SCMS est d'assurer la fourniture de médicaments essentiels et d'autres produits de qualité aux personnes touchées par le VIH/SIDA, et de promouvoir des chaînes d'approvisionnement durables dans les pays partenaires, en collaboration avec les agences américaines et d'autres parties prenantes. SCMS soutient l'intensification rapide de la prévention, des soins et du traitement du VIH/SIDA en fournissant un approvisionnement ininterrompu en produits essentiels. CMS est mis en œuvre par le Partnership for Supply Chain Management, un consortium à but non lucratif de 13 organisations dirigé par John Snow, Inc. Research & Training Institute (JSI) et Management Sciences forHealth (MSH).

Fournir aux missions et bureaux de l'USAID un mécanisme mondial pour soutenir les buts et objectifs de l'Initiative du Président contre le paludisme et l'objectif de l'USAID de réduire le fardeau du paludisme en Afrique. Il soutiendra la mise en œuvre par l'USAID des programmes de prévention et de traitement du paludisme à travers l'achat, la gestion et la livraison de produits antipaludiques de haute qualité, sûrs et efficaces ; la fourniture de capacités logistiques sur le terrain, d'une assistance technique et d'une expertise en matière de gestion pharmaceutique ; et un leadership technique pour renforcer l'offre, la demande et le financement mondiaux de produits antipaludiques de haute qualité.

title.narrative: Pan American Health Organization (PAHO)
Organización Panamericana de la Salud (OPS)

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): <!--br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}-->This grant to PAHO through the LAC/Regional Program will accelerate malaria elimination by strengthening capacity for vector management, diagnosis, treatment and surveillance. Reflecting U.S. leadership commitment in preventing child and maternal deaths, PAHO will improve national health plans, monitor and evaluate interventions, facilitate policy dialogue and support the network of sentinel hospitals and midwifery associations in competency-based education. FY 2019 funds will support the regional health information system network, the Secretariat, and working groups for Every Woman Every Child-LAC, a partnership that empowers countries to interpret, document, communicate and address health inequalities. Finally, they will support health workforce transformation and implementation of Human Resources for Health 2030. As the specialized health agency of the Inter-American System and WHO Regional Office for the Americas, PAHO has the unique ability to convene and coordinate LAC countries in the adoption of evidence-based guidelines and policies to provide the best prevention, diagnosis, care and treatment for those at risk for TB. With 52 member countries and territories, PAHO sets regional health priorities and mobilizes action to address transborder health problems by partnering with ministries of health and other local and international health players. USAID selected PAHO to implement activities that strengthen national TB programs and other infectious diseases, by providing technical assistance throughout the region to ensure adoption of evidence-based policies in surveillance, detection and treatment, in order to leverage PAHO's existing relationships with country programs as well as its unique standing as a recognized technical leader. USAID's funds leverage the expertise of PAHO and contributions from other donors to ensure coordinated, effective and efficient public health programming without

(USAID Global Health (GH)): <!--br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}-->Esta donación a la OPS a través del Programa Regional/LAC acelerará la eliminación de la malaria fortaleciendo la capacidad para el manejo, diagnóstico, tratamiento y vigilancia de vectores. Como reflejo del compromiso de liderazgo de Estados Unidos en la prevención de muertes infantiles y maternas, la OPS mejorará los planes nacionales de salud, monitoreará y evaluará las intervenciones, facilitará el diálogo sobre políticas y apoyará la red de hospitales centinela y asociaciones de parteras en la educación basada en competencias. Los fondos del año fiscal 2019 apoyarán la red regional del sistema de información de salud, la Secretaría y los grupos de trabajo de Every Woman Every Child-LAC, una asociación que empodera a los países para interpretar, documentar, comunicar y abordar las desigualdades en salud. Finalmente, apoyarán la transformación del personal de salud y la implementación de Recursos Humanos para la Salud 2030. Como agencia de salud especializada del Sistema Interamericano y Oficina Regional de la OMS para las Américas, la OPS tiene la capacidad única de convocar y coordinar a los países de ALC en la adopción de directrices y políticas basadas en evidencia para brindar la mejor prevención, diagnóstico, atención y tratamiento a quienes corren riesgo de contraer tuberculosis. Con 52 países y territorios miembros, la OPS establece prioridades de salud regionales y moviliza acciones para abordar los problemas de salud transfronterizos asociándose con ministerios de salud y otros actores de salud locales e internacionales. USAID seleccionó a la OPS para implementar actividades que fortalezcan los programas nacionales de tuberculosis y otras enfermedades infecciosas, brindando asistencia técnica en toda la región para garantizar la adopción de políticas basadas en evidencia en vigilancia, detección y tratamiento, con el fin de aprovechar las relaciones existentes de la OPS con los programas de país, así como su posición única como líder técnico reconocido. Los fondos de USAID aprovechan la experiencia de la OPS y las contribuciones de otros donantes para garantizar una programación de salud pública coordinada, eficaz y eficiente.

title.narrative: OECD/DAC - International Dialogue

description.narrative: (USAID Policy, Planning and Learning (PPL)): PPL will provide voluntary contributions to the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development Assistance Committee (OECD-DAC) to support its 2016-2017 Program of Work and Budget (PWB). The OECD-DAC is one of two partner organizations comprising the joint support team of the Global Partnership for Effective Development Cooperation (GPEDC). The joint support team supports operational preparations for Steering Committee and ministerial-level meetings, advisory support to the Steering Committee and co-chairs, critical capacity building and monitoring work at the country level, and may directly undertake some studies. FY 2015 activities supported under the OECD-DAC's 2015-16 PWB include the GPEDC, peer reviews, development finance and triangular cooperation.

description.narrative: With funding from the U.S. Agency for International Development, IDEAInforming Decisionmakers to Actincreases support among policy audiences for effective health and population programs around the world. In implementing IDEA, PRB brings a fresh vision to policy communication. By increasing the flow of accurate, understandable information about population, family planning, and reproductive health to policy audiences, IDEA enhances efforts carried out by civil society, the public sector, the development community, and donors. IDEA develops materials on priority issues in cutting-edge formats; trains and supports media to influence policy change; builds the communications capacity of institutions, researchers, and advocates; and nurtures a community of policy champions.

title.narrative: Cooperative Development Program (CDP) - Land O' Lakes (LOL), 2010

description.narrative: The production and marketing of milk generates income and employment opportunities for millions worldwide and provides an important source of nutrition to women, children and households. Dairy cooperatives in both developed and developing countries play a critical role in moving milk from farms to consumer markets. However, increasing global demand for milk and dairy products is attracting both domestic and international competition in dairy producing countries, especially those in East Africa, which have a rich history and culture of keeping livestock and cultural acceptance of milk consumption. Dairy cooperatives not only must compete with private sector processors, informal sector traders and vendors in the marketplace, but they also have to compete with these same businesses for farmers' milk. In response to this competition, a number of dairy cooperatives in developing countries have succeeded in horizontally and/or vertically integrating their operations to achieve scale, increase their competitive position in the marketplace, maximize returns to members, and engender member loyalty.Land O'Lakes (LOL) assists partner- cooperatives in Uganda and Kenya in addressing the most pressing issues by facilitating access to solutions that assist cooperatives to effectively manage scale through horizontal and vertical integration. This project also focuses on Cooperative Development Partners (CDP) in creating partnerships that contribute to self-reliant enterprises that meet the needs of participating members.
